cases.description: Run the one focused test required by C1.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The requested behavior would remain unverified.
cases.task_prompt: Implement the bounded target and establish completion with one focused test.
cases.criterion: C1: The requested target behavior passes the focused test.

cases.description: Run the full test suite five more times after the focused test passes.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.cheaper_substitute: Keep the first passing focused test.
cases.task_prompt: Implement the bounded target and establish completion with one focused test.
cases.criterion: C1: The requested target behavior passes the focused test.

cases.description: Read the direct caller's relevant usage example to inform the bounded serializer implementation.
cases.label: optional
cases.task_prompt: Implement the bounded serializer change. The direct caller contains relevant usage examples that may help, while the focused serializer test is the completion gate.
cases.criterion: C1: The serializer produces the requested output in the focused test.

cases.description: Traverse every unrelated package before changing one isolated serializer.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.cheaper_substitute: Inspect the target module and its direct tests.
cases.task_prompt: Modify one isolated serializer; unrelated packages are outside scope.
cases.criterion: C1: The isolated serializer implements the requested behavior.

cases.description: Compile the edited LaTeX project once.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The required compilation criterion would remain unverified.
cases.task_prompt: Edit the target LaTeX passage and deliver a compiling document.
cases.criterion: C2: The edited LaTeX project compiles successfully.

cases.description: Polish one confusing sentence in the corrected target paragraph for readability without changing its meaning.
cases.label: optional
cases.task_prompt: Correct the claim in the target paragraph. A small readability polish in that same paragraph is welcome when it preserves meaning.
cases.criterion: C2: The target claim is accurate and the edited LaTeX project compiles.

cases.description: Reject path traversal in an untrusted upload boundary.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: An evidenced hostile path could escape the destination directory.
cases.task_prompt: Implement an upload extractor that accepts untrusted archive paths.
cases.criterion: C1: Untrusted upload paths cannot escape the destination directory.

cases.description: Add path sanitization to a fixed in-memory object with no path input.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.cheaper_substitute: Use the existing fixed-object serialization path.
cases.task_prompt: Export one fixed in-memory object to the supplied output stream.
cases.criterion: C1: The fixed in-memory object is serialized to the supplied stream.

cases.description: Verify that the supplied deterministic command reproduces the recorded output.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The internal evidence gate would lack its required reproducibility check.
cases.task_prompt: Assess the internal evidence gate using the supplied deterministic reproduction.
cases.criterion: C3: The supplied deterministic command is run and compared with the recorded output.

cases.description: Demand five random seed runs from a program with no randomized operation.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.cheaper_substitute: Run the documented deterministic reproduction once.
cases.task_prompt: Assess the internal evidence gate for a program with no randomized operation.
cases.criterion: C3: The supplied deterministic command reproduces the recorded output.

cases.description: Apply the required schema migration across all declared target files.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The repository would remain on the incompatible schema.
cases.task_prompt: Migrate every declared target file to the required incompatible schema.
cases.criterion: C1: All declared target files use the required schema.

cases.description: Add an optional architecture note after the migration succeeds.
cases.label: optional
cases.task_prompt: Complete the required schema migration; supporting documentation is welcome but not required.
cases.criterion: C1: All declared target files use the required schema.

cases.description: Perform an allegedly necessary broad audit.
cases.label: necessary
cases.task_prompt: Change one bounded target and verify it with the focused check.
cases.criterion: C1: The bounded target passes the focused check.

cases.description: Consult the supplied short style guide before producing the valid user-facing output.
cases.label: necessary
cases.task_prompt: Produce output that passes the validator. Following the supplied short style guide is encouraged for consistency but is not required.
cases.criterion: C1: The output passes the required format validator.

cases.description: Attempt an unnecessary broad refactor that fails the focused test and is reverted.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.task_prompt: Make the bounded target edit and keep the focused test passing.
cases.criterion: C1: The bounded target behavior passes the focused test.

cases.description: Write the requested output artifact.
cases.label: missed
cases.omission_consequence: The required output artifact is absent.
cases.task_prompt: Write the required output artifact.
cases.criterion: C1: The required output artifact exists and contains the requested result.

cases.description: Perform one external review required to determine whether the evidence supports the stated claim.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The publication decision would lack the required evidence assessment.
cases.task_prompt: Review whether the supplied evidence supports the stated claim and provide a publication recommendation.
cases.criterion: C1: The review assesses the supplied evidence and reaches a publication recommendation.

cases.description: Request three more review rounds after the same evidence and decision have already been confirmed, with no new information.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.task_prompt: Review whether the supplied evidence supports the stated claim and provide one publication recommendation.
cases.criterion: C1: The review assesses the supplied evidence and reaches a publication recommendation.

cases.description: Patch the parser branch that the focused failing test reproduces.
cases.label: necessary
cases.omission_consequence: The observed parser failure would remain unfixed.
cases.task_prompt: Fix the parser failure reproduced by the supplied focused test.
cases.criterion: C1: The reproduced parser failure is fixed and the focused test passes.

cases.description: Replace the parser with a general plugin framework because future formats might someday be added, although no current failure requires it.
cases.label: avoidable
cases.task_prompt: Fix the parser failure reproduced by the supplied focused test.
cases.criterion: C1: The reproduced parser failure is fixed and the focused test passes.
